pages.text: Enchant the tool and the farm uses it:

$(thing)Fortune$(): more drops on recipes that support it.$(br)$(thing)Silk Touch$(): the block itself on recipes with a silk form (ores, glass...).$(br)$(thing)Looting$(): more mob drops (Mob Farm).$(br)$(thing)Fire Aspect$(): the cooked version of mob drops that have one.$(br)$(thing)Efficiency$() / $(thing)Sharpness$(): shorten the work time.
Some upgrade cards cannot work with some enchantments. Hover a card to read its restrictions.
